messages.author: d30d671910959596
messages.subject: TMT analysis with FragPipe data
parts:
Hi,
I wanted to use TMT MSStats for some data I have searched using Fragpipe and while I can get the data loaded into MSstatTMT and can process it I have problem with getting the annotation work. 
I have 8 tissue extracts each in duplicate in my TMTpro 16-plex and the labeled sample was fractionated to 8 fractions. My annotation file is attached.
While Channel and Run get uploaded by PhilosophertoMSstatsTMTFormat the other (Mixture, etc) show <NA>

I was also looking for correction of the isotopic cross-channel contamination, but could not find a way to do it in MSstatsTMT. Is the expectation that this is done by the Search engine (e.g. MaxQuant does it)?

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,
Tomas

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: TMT analysis with FragPipe data
parts:
Hi,

sorry for a late response,
it is not an option in MSstatsTMT and needs to be handled by the search engine.
I have looked at the annotation but I don't see an issue right now. Something might be going wrong when the converter handles fractionation. Could you please share a small snippet of feature data? It can be anonymized by changing condition or protein IDs and I only need one to few proteins to reproduce the issue.


Kind regards,
Mateusz

parts:
Hi Devon et al,
I tried and got the annotation.fp file uploaded fine from the "experiment_annotation.tsv file created by FragPipe. However, when I then try to use PhilosophertoMSstats:
msstatsTMTdata<-PhilosophertoMSstatsTMTFormat(raw,annotation = annotation.fp,
                                              protein_id_col="Gene",peptide_id_col = "Peptide.Sequence",
                                              rmPSM_withfewMea_withinRun=FALSE)

I get error -
Error in .checkAnnotation(input, annotation) :
  ** Columns Run, Condition, BioReplicate missing in the annotation. Please check the annotation file.

the column names created by FragPipe are :
> colnames(annotation.fp)
[1] "plex"        "channel"     "sample"      "sample_name" "condition"   "replicate"

clearly not what MSstatsTMT is expecting.
> packageVersion("MSstatsTMT")
[1] ‘2.6.1’
> packageVersion("MSstats")
[1] ‘4.6.3’

FragPipe - v19.1, MSFragger 3.7, IonQuant 1.8.10, Philosopher 4.8.0, Python 3.9.13, EasyPQP 0.1.36.

Am I using up to date packages and Fragpipe (it seems so).

Tomas
